paragraphs: Rabbi Yannai bar Ammi HaKohen and Rabbi Zerika came to Rabbi Yehudah be-Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi’s house: Chullin 111a. This gives some support that Rabbi Yannai was Rabbi Ammi’s father-in-law and he named his son Yannai after his father-in-law. ‘In Rav Safra’s time’: I do not know whence he derived this.
